pages.text: $(l)Density$(): the creature lifts off the ground and hovers. Take more and it rises higher, and higher. Only a $(l)lead$() keeps it down. Take all of it and it drifts into the sky, never to return.

$(l)Speed$(): it slows, then stops.$(br)$(l)Size$(): it shrinks.$(br)$(l)Awareness$(): it thinks less often. Emptied, it becomes $(o)Vacant$(): breathing, standing, doing nothing.$(br)$(l)Time$(): the young grow up at once. The old wither, and when the last moment is gone, they crumble.
